title.zh: 【币安黑客卖出 7.77 万亿枚 PEPE 换回 14049 枚 ETH，致币价暴跌 12.33%】

current_state.zh: An attacker drained 7.77 trillion PEPE from a Binance hot wallet and sold it for 14,049 ETH (~$31.9M at an average of $0.0000041), crashing the token's price by 12.33%.
